title: machine/wsl: detect native systemd as running
body:
<!-- Thanks for sending a pull request! -->
This fixes the way we find systemd for Windows Subsystem for Linux distributions that use systemd.

Now we look for a systemd process that starts with /lib/systemd/systemd.. In my Windows Subsystem for Linux environment systemd is running as the main process and it uses /usr/lib/systemd/systemd. So the current way of checking does not. Podman might think systemd has stopped incorrectly.

This change first checks what process is running as the process. If it is not systemd it goes back to the way of checking. This means that the way it worked before still works.

I tried this out on Windows Subsystem for Linux. I saw that the old way of checking was not working.. When I checked what process was running as the main process I saw that it was systemd. I also tested the fix with go test. It worked fine.

* The change is for Windows Subsystem, for Linux

* It checks for systemd in a way

* The old way of checking still works if the new way does not find systemd

* I tested it. It works fine now

comments.body:
I closed the same change in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/pull/29394, what is different here?
I still do not see any issues reference here.

Is that alone is actually good enough to support the systemd mode, doesn't the bootstrap script still try to launch systemd normally? 

Anyhow I guess this needs to wait for @l0rd to have time to take a proper look at.

I checked bootstrap flow. The bootstrap script checks if systemd is already running and exits before starting the nested /lib/systemd/systemd, so it seems native systemd would prevent that launch.

But I also saw that sysdpid, enterns, profile and waitTerm still specifically look for /lib/systemd/systemd. And so I am not sure that just changing the running-state detection is enough for native systemd support.

This PR applies the same main approach as #29394 . I will not make any more changes until I get feedback from @l0rd.
@badal-coder Any update on this? Or can we close the PR?
